mechanism: Pyrazinamide can cause hyperuricemia and gout, while tretinoin increases photosensitivity and skin toxicity risk; concurrent use may potentiate adverse dermatological effects and complicate gout management.
action: Monitor for hyperuricemia, gout flares, and enhanced photosensitivity; ensure strict sun protection during tretinoin therapy and consider uric acid monitoring; assess risk-benefit ratio before coadministration.
